name: Sophia Gertrude Meier

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married George Thomas Duffin (b. 1 Jun 1880 Easton; clerk; of 243 Canal St, Easton), by E. M. Stapleton. Northampton Co. licence No. 10968, sworn 3 Jun 1903. She gave her birth as Hazleton, Luzerne Co., 12 Nov 1880, residing at Easton, at home.

bioAdditions: Sophia's own marriage licence confirms her birth on 12 Nov 1880 at Hazleton (S1). She was living at Easton when she married the clerk George Thomas Duffin there on 3 Jun 1903. She died at Easton on 3 Apr 1909, aged 28 (S2). A family twist: in 1917 the widower George T. Duffin married Agatha Mary Rose, daughter of Sophia's sister Mary (Meier) Rose. His second wife was therefore his first wife's niece (S2).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Her own licence gives her name, birth date and birthplace.
